title: clodex run event
description: One line of <run_dir>/events.ndjson. Events are authoritative; the run snapshot is a derived reduction over them. schema_version, seq and t are stamped by append_event; every other field is event-type specific payload.

schema_version.description: Event contract version. 1 for clodex v0.1.

seq.description: Monotonic sequence number, assigned at append time from the last valid line.

t.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp, stamped at append time. The reducer never reads the wall clock, so all snapshot timestamps come from here.

e.description: Event type. The reducer rejects anything outside this vocabulary.

preflight.description: Optional, on any event: the result of a preflight run. Recorded as a field rather than an event because the vocabulary above is frozen. Appended to the snapshot's `preflight` list, so a resumed run that checks again adds a second record rather than replacing the first.

status.description: pass | fail | warn — the verdict for the whole run of checks.

codex.description: Optional, on any event: one leg of a Codex role invocation, appended to the snapshot's `invocations` list. One entry per leg and never merged — a resumed round overwrites its own envelope on disk, so the interrupted leg's duration survives only here, and summing the legs is what makes cost accounting true.

invocation_id.description: The runner's invocation id; also the envelope's basename.

round.description: Review round, where the role runs in rounds.

status.description: The envelope's status: complete | partial | failed | interrupted.

envelope.description: Path to the result envelope, which the manifest otherwise never mentions.

input_hashes.description: sha256 of each artifact the role read — this is what binds a review to a plan version.

resumed.description: True on the leg that resumed an interrupted one.

severity.description: finding:recorded only. Free string, because the vocabulary is the source's: plan review grades blocker/high/medium/low/info, code review Critical/Important/Minor.

summary.description: finding:recorded only: one line naming the defect.

round.description: finding:recorded only: the review round that raised it.

invocation.description: finding:recorded only: the `codex.invocation_id` that raised it.

plan_hash.description: On plan:approved and approval:granted, the hash the approval binds to. On finding:recorded, the plan hash the finding was raised against.
